title: EasyLEED-ViPErLEED compatibility under the common Gaussian estimator
claim_limits: ViPErLEED is a separate whole-pattern external reference, not a sixth method in the five-strategy matrix.
The comparison assesses compatibility under different initialization contracts and does not supply position or identity ground truth.
Pair residuals are conditional on five valid P1 images and three valid P2 images per method.
